title: SensitivityTier
description: Privacy classification for ontology labels. Higher tiers require stronger consent before data is stored or returned. Ordering: tier_public < tier_work < tier_personal < tier_sensitive < tier_internal.

documentation.tier_public: Level 1 (lowest). Safe to share broadly. Examples: preferred language, communication style.
documentation.tier_work: Level 2. Professional context. Examples: job title, employer, work email.
documentation.tier_personal: Level 3. Personal but non-sensitive. Examples: hobbies, food preferences, pet names.
documentation.tier_sensitive: Level 4. Sensitive personal data. Examples: health conditions, financial information, religion.
documentation.tier_internal: Level 5 (highest). Never shared externally — internal agent use only. Examples: internal identifiers, processing metadata.
